Annexure-I (SOW) SCOPE OF WORK: 1. Objective of the Work The work involves providing protective fencing between the Headgear structure and the Winder Room of N o. 4 Shaft, Surda Copper Mine, to restrict unauthorized access and ensure the safety of personnel and prot ection of the winding installation. The fencing shall be fabricated and erected as per the approved sketch/drawing provided by Hindustan Co pper Limited (HCL), including all necessary structural steel members, MS sheet coverings, supports, found ations, gate and painting. The contractor shall undertake the following activities: 1. Supply of Materials The contractor shall arrange and supply all materials required for completion of the work, including but not limited to: · ISMB 300 structural steel sections. · ISMC 100 structural steel channels. · MS plates of 2.00 mm thickness for top covering, as indicated in the drawing. · MS plates of 3.15 mm thickness for front/lower covering, as indicated in the drawing. · Expanded metal mesh/net (Min. wire diameter should be 6.0 mm)for providing the protective shade over the road, as shown in the drawing.

· Steel sections, flats, angles and other supporting members required for fabrication. · Bolts, nuts, washers, anchor fasteners and other fastening materials. · Cement, sand, aggregates and other materials required for construction of civil foundations. · Welding electrodes, cutting discs, grinding materials and other consumables. · One coat red oxide primer and two coats of aluminium paint. · All other materials, accessories and fittings necessary for satisfactory completion of the job. · All Steel materials shall be new, unused and of TATA/SAIL/JINDAL make. 2. Fabrication of Fencing Structure · Fabrication of the complete fencing structure shall be carried out in accordance with the approved dr awing. · Structural members shall be cut, drilled, welded and assembled to the required dimensions. · ISMB 300 and ISMC 100 sections shall be used at the locations indicated in the drawing. · MS sheets of 2.00 mm and 3.15 mm thickness shall be fitted at the respective locations as indicated in the drawing. · All joints shall be properly welded to ensure adequate strength and rigidity. · Necessary stiffeners, brackets, supporting members and connecting arrangements shall be provided wherever required. · Suitable provision shall be made for the winding rope to pass through the designated rope window w ithout obstruction or interference with rope movement. · A suitable access gate shall be fabricated and installed at the location indicated in the plan. · The fencing shall be properly aligned and fabricated to match the existing site conditions and the ap proved drawing.Slight variation in the design may be considered as per site condition & suitability of w ork. 3. Civil Foundation Work · The contractor shall undertake the construction of concrete foundations for 10 (Ten) structural colum ns as indicated in the drawing. · The work shall include excavation, preparation of foundation beds, concreting, fixing of anchor bolts/ base plates and associated civil works. · The foundation dimensions and concrete specifications shall be finalized in consultation with the Engi neer-in-Charge based on site conditions and structural requirements.

· All columns shall be securely anchored to their respective foundations. · The foundations shall be properly cured and allowed to attain adequate strength before undertaking structural erection. 4. Erection and Installation · All structural columns, beams, channels and supporting members shall be installed in their respectiv e positions. · The MS sheet coverings and expanded metal mesh shall be properly fixed. · The access gate shall be installed with suitable hinges, locking arrangements and necessary fittings. · The contractor shall ensure proper alignment, stability and rigidity of the complete fencing structure. · The fencing shall be securely connected to the existing structure wherever indicated in the drawing. · Adequate clearance shall be maintained around the winding rope and associated moving component s. · The completed structure shall not obstruct the movement of personnel, winding rope, skip or any oth er operational equipment. 5. Surface Preparation and Painting: Painting shall be carried out after completion of fabrication and erecti on. The painting work shall consist of: · Cleaning of all steel surfaces to remove rust, dirt, oil, grease, welding slag and other foreign mat erials. · Application of one coat of red oxide primer over all exposed steel surfaces. · Application of two coats of aluminium paint over the primer. · Each coat shall be allowed to dry adequately before application of the subsequent coat. · The final finish shall be uniform and free from peeling, patches and unpainted areas. 3.0 Delivery-- Supply of all material -- Within one month from the date of placement of order. Erection & Painting -- Within two months after supply of material at site. 4.0 Payment -- 30 days credit. 40% of the order value will be released after complete supply of materials a t site and after satisfactory inspection by Engr.-in-charge.
